decision.rationale: Prefer Ledger-first over Entry-first as the base. It better balances recording a purchase with understanding its effect on balance and history, while keeping the entry task nearby on desktop. This is a preference, not approval of Ledger-first unchanged.

pairwiseComparison.rationale: Ledger-first preserves broad history and nearby entry together; Entry-first gives the form more dominance than the evidence and product balance require.
